geometry.basis: All 13 declared ramps have continuous full-width native profiles, zero blocked samples, max step <=2.071 and endpoint error <=0.04. Actual approaches and resource connections are traced separately, with full functional reservations. No source-mask changes or height changes outside authorized ramp footprints.

materials.basis: Both native blend planes and cliff-index plane exported for the complete grid. First-plane blends occupy 44472 cells; second-plane and cliff-UV indices are zero, so no uninspected active secondary/cliff mapping. Native references and atlas validated. All 13 ramp windows show continuous terrain material across the pass; side cliff strips terminate at the opening and connect to unchanged tier edges. Original open-sea cliff coastline retains a sand marker, not a falsely labelled amphibious transition.
materials.limitation: Field schematic supports material placement/transition alignment. Actual diffuse/normal texture and engine water appearance were not rendered, and no gameplay/GUI claim is made.

navigation.basis: Full 24-cell ramp lanes open in both directions; all 432 base/resource routes reachable; eight final full-reservation combat corridors >=10.2368 cells; 96 production branch base-to-exit paths connected under full foundation union. Shores are measured symmetric barriers, not designated amphibious access.
